payload.title: Multi-app & multi-tenant isolation: per-app storage partitioning, tenant admin
payload.description:
Today multi-app servers route by URL prefix + WebSocket Hello schema id, but storage, configured handlers, projection registries, job workers, and processors are all shared at the server level (status.md; operations.md:727-730 "V1 scopes app boundaries to URL routing and Hello handshake only — storage is server-shared").

Scope:
- Per-app storage partitioning (app_id column on relevant tables + read/write scoping) (operations.md:727-730).
- Per-app handler/projection/job-worker registries instead of server-global.
- Tenant administration: assignment is per-session/per-account today with no admin route for moving an account between tenants (threat-model.md:338-339).

Target: true app/tenant isolation so one server can host multiple apps/tenants without shared blast radius.
